title: Phase-indexed test states
statement: Given two finite Turing machines $M_V$ and $M_I$ over the Boolean alphabet, associate a state type to each test-machine phase. The anchor phase has a singleton state type; identity has the cleaning states for $M_I$ together with a singleton alternative; rewind has the rewind states together with a singleton alternative; copy has the three sweep phases; call has a singleton alternative together with a Boolean paired with a choice among the rewind states, a singleton alternative, the cleaning states for $M_V$ together with a singleton alternative, and another copy of the rewind states; verdict has the verdict states.
hypotheses_covered: two finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
